page.overview:
What is Charcadet?

Charcadet is a small humanoid Pokémon. It has a bulky, black, charcoal helmet-like formation on its forehead that comprises most of its face, with burning red notches and a dark red lining at the back of the "helmet". Three teardrop-shaped markings form a slight triangular shape on the front of the helmet, and the lower part of its face is back with no visible mouth. It has bright red flaming eyes with yellow irises and white scleras. A plume of red fire with a tint of purple and blue at the tip billows out from the back of its round head. The back of its head is red and orange. Its torso resembles a knight's armor, red in colour with fiery tips, and a slightly protruding orange formation in its center. Its black arms and legs are thick and its red paws and feet are stubby with only one thumb-like digit on each paw. The lower half of its body is black. An orange flame billows out continuously from the center of its back.

Shiny Charcadet look nearly identical to the normal version, with the only difference being the bright blue and cyan colour of its eyes.

It is said that a burnt piece of charcoal leapt from the fire, came to life and took on the form of Charcadet. It possesses a fiery, knight-like spirit and is a very skilled young warrior Pokémon. Charcadet is able to take on stronger opponents much larger than itself. It prefers to eat berries that are rich in fats.

During fights, Charcadet can increase its firepower to temperatures over 1,000 degrees Celsius (1,800 degrees Fahrenheit).
